business_problem: Google Cloud's demand engine was receiving growing volumes of increasingly complex leads, but lead preparation still depended on manual, batch-based enrichment. That made it difficult to add trusted buyer, account, and market context quickly enough for timely sales engagement and created a bottleneck between marketing and sales.
solution_summary: Google Cloud and Accenture rebuilt lead enrichment as an always-on agentic AI operating model embedded directly into Google Cloud's go-to-market workflows. The production system uses a multi-agent design built on Vertex AI, BigQuery, and Gemini to prepare, enrich, validate, and prioritize inbound leads in real time instead of in manual batches. Agents draw on internal data, third-party sources, and refreshed enriched datasets to identify the right buyer contacts, roles, account context, and market signals, then assemble decision-ready lead records for sellers. BigQuery serves as the data foundation for the datasets the agents use and refresh, Gemini provides the model intelligence behind enrichment and validation decisions, and Vertex AI supports the production-scale agent workflow. Quality is governed through direct output review, benchmarking against human performance, risk-based sampling, edge-case routing to human reviewers, continuous audit loops, and operational monitoring for retries and time-outs.

solution_components.name: Vertex AI
solution_components.role: Hosts and runs the production-scale multi-agent lead enrichment and validation workflow.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Provides the data foundation for internal, third-party, and enriched datasets used by the agents.

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Supplies the model intelligence used to enrich leads and validate buyer and account matches.

data_flow: Inbound lead records enter Google Cloud's go-to-market workflow, where agents pull context from internal data, third-party sources, and refreshed enriched datasets. The multi-agent system built on Vertex AI, BigQuery, and Gemini enriches and validates buyer, account, and market signals in real time, routes edge cases to human review, and returns decision-ready leads to sellers for follow-up.
business_outcome: The agentic AI system delivers faster, higher-quality lead enrichment at production scale, reduces manual preparation work, helps sellers focus on qualified opportunities, increases sales productivity, accelerates conversion, and lowers cost-to-serve while maintaining trust through human oversight and continuous quality controls.
metrics: 4 hours to process 25,000 inbound records — reduced from nearly a week

Continuous audit loops improve performance over time.
Monitoring handles retries and time-outs under real demand.
